"""Independent T3 source-frame and failure-tail probes, no original files."""
import json
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

from company_wiki.document_understanding.text_boundaries import terminal_punctuation
from company_wiki.resource_budget import WorkBudget
from company_wiki.source_catalog.narrative_native_materials import prepare_native_materials
from unit.document_understanding_note_scope.fixtures import (
    Row, inherited_heading_ids, run_pipeline, source,
)


def test_note_limit_cannot_release_unexamined_suffix_as_complete_material():
    box=(72.,80.,528.,700.)
    rows=[Row('intro','備註三十一：丙方的设备交付及服务义务：',block=0,box=box)]
    rows.extend(Row(f'b{i}',f'“{i+1}、公司已交付检测设备，丙方应保留原始验收记录。”',block=0,box=box) for i in range(27))
    rows.extend([Row('healthy','一、另一项业务进展',block=1,box=(72.,710.,528.,730.)),
                 Row('healthy_body','公司已交付独立的新设备。',block=2,box=(72.,740.,528.,760.))])
    parsed,owned=source(tuple(rows))
    result,contexts=run_pipeline(parsed)
    packages,_facts,continuity,blocked=prepare_native_materials(parsed,result,
        work_budget=WorkBudget(16_000_000),_native_contexts=contexts)
    evidence={'diagnostics':result['structure']['diagnostics'],
      'semantic_units':result['structure']['semantic_units'],
      'blocked':sorted(blocked),'anchors':[p['anchor_unit_ids'] for p in packages],
      'names':{key:unit.unit_id for key,unit in owned.items()},'continuity_complete':continuity['complete']}
    (Path(__file__).parent/'limit-observation.json').write_text(json.dumps(evidence,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
    # The first over-limit target and following members are still within the
    # same explicit note; a budget boundary is not a new source introduction.
    assert {owned[f'b{i}'].unit_id for i in (23,24,25,26)} <= set(blocked)
    assert all(not {owned[f'b{i}'].unit_id for i in (23,24,25,26)} & set(p['anchor_unit_ids']) for p in packages)
    assert owned['healthy_body'].unit_id not in blocked
    assert any(owned['healthy_body'].unit_id in p['anchor_unit_ids'] for p in packages)


@pytest.mark.parametrize('tail,expected',[
    ('原文已完成。』 )\n','。'),
    ('Ready!\" ]  ','!'),
    ('1.3 New platform (2027)',None),
    ('原文称“已完成。”但仍需验收',None),
])
def test_terminal_only_observes_the_actual_end(tail,expected):
    assert terminal_punctuation(tail)==expected


def test_new_same_actor_note_resets_frame_and_keeps_its_own_intro():
    rows=(Row('outer','一、经营进展'),
          Row('intro1','备注３１：丙方关于原服务的承诺：'),
          Row('a','“1、丙方履行原服务约定。”'),
          Row('intro2','備註三十一：丙方关于新服务的单独承诺：'),
          Row('b','“1、丙方履行新服务约定。”'))
    parsed,owned=source(rows)
    result,_contexts=run_pipeline(parsed)
    context=inherited_heading_ids(result,owned['b'])
    assert owned['intro2'].unit_id in context and owned['outer'].unit_id in context
    assert not {owned['intro1'].unit_id,owned['a'].unit_id}&context


def test_geometry_coverage_is_not_upgraded_by_exact_member_scope():
    box=(72.,80.,528.,160.)
    parsed,owned=source((Row('intro','备注３１：丙方服务范围：',block=0,box=box),
                        Row('body','“1、丙方的检测平台已完成调试。”',block=0,box=box)),geometry=False)
    result,contexts=run_pipeline(parsed)
    assert owned['intro'].unit_id in inherited_heading_ids(result,owned['body'])
    assert contexts[parsed.source_id].member_neighbour(owned['intro'].unit_id,owned['body'].unit_id) is not None
    assert any(d['code']=='LAYOUT_GEOMETRY_UNAVAILABLE' for d in result.get('diagnostics',[]))
    assert not result['structure']['coverage']['complete']
